description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableJsonArrayNull' that implements JSON null and array interfaces, representing a null value as a JSON array.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArrayNull
classes.description: An immutable singleton class representing a JSON null value as a JSON array.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ImmutableJsonArrayNull.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Indicates that this value is null.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Indicates that this value is an array.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns this object as a JsonArray.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Methods to add various types to the array, all returning the same null array instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index, always empty.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the array contains a specific JsonValue, always false.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a value, always 0.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns an empty stream of JsonValues.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, true if object is a JsonNull.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on JsonNull class.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of null literal.
